name: RC-B10-0191/2024 – After § 4 – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
part_text: 4a. Underlines Poland’s crucial role as a leader in supporting Ukraine from the very first days of the war; recalls that Poland was the first country to deliver significant amounts of heavy weaponry to the Ukrainian front; notes that Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport played a key role as a logistical hub for sending international military and humanitarian aid to Ukraine, which enabled an effective defence against the aggressor during the critical early months of the war; appreciates the tremendous efforts of Polish society, which welcomed millions of refugees, demonstrating solidarity and humanitarian support on an unprecedented scale;
